name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 31 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-06-26, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.14 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
